review.imagery: Root reviewed all 31 original current brochure spreads, all 17 extracted native resources and all 16 cached current website/drawing resources. Twelve selected native renders retain actual Bristol/Ramhan context. Historical Belgrade photographs, generic yacht and couple lifestyle photographs, abstract water/chair details and repeated crops were excluded. Published hotel lobby, wellness, bar and dining concepts remain explicitly shared hospitality spaces. Private apartment interior applicability and resident access are unverified.
review.floorPlans: Root viewed all four original full-resolution whole JPEG drawing spreads and read every numeric panel, level key and notice. Printed sums independently check 58.72+9.86=68.58, 89.33+18.63=107.96, 134.85+51.72=186.57 and 170.47+67.56=238.03 m². Whole original source JPEG bytes remain unchanged. Two complete developer master/regional sheets retain community scope and physical PDF pages. The current official 31-spread PDF has no individual apartment plans. Sixteen other broker table rows lack public drawings in the reviewed set.
review.location: Root read the whole original community master/regional sheets and official factsheet page 3. Five published community driving estimates remain qualified. No surveyed hotel entrance, precise pin, current live route or kilometre journey was inferred.
review.provenance: Normal-GET receipts retain current official site/brochure URLs and independent broker original drawing URLs, dates, bytes and SHA256. Broker image hosting remains accurately labelled. Hotel/Belgrade and private-residence/shared-hospitality scope remain distinct. Existing commercial research and protected identities are preserved.

unavailable: Drawings for the sixteen remaining broker table types, contracted revision and level, confirmed private apartment interiors, resident hospitality access, surveyed Bristol entrance coordinates and kilometre journeys remain unavailable or unverified.
